entry.title: Amazon deploys thousands of smart glasses to delivery drivers
entry.summary: The glasses provide navigation and drop-off instructions within drivers' field of view, part of the company's effort to boost delivery efficiency.

entry.title: USTR urged to permanently suspend China-linked ship fees
entry.summary: Stakeholders such as the World Shipping Council and the National Retail Federation are concerned fees will “add another cost layer to an already strained transportation system.”

entry.title: Logitech launches supply chain decarbonization program
entry.summary: The computer peripheral manufacturer’s Chain Reaction initiative will start with 17 suppliers pooling purchasing power to collectively buy renewable electricity.

entry.title: EBay trims Depop shipping rates, bolsters delivery features
entry.summary: The company is using AI to enable fast-but-reliable delivery promises and help sellers determine shipping costs more easily, CEO Jamie Iannone said.

entry.title: Urban Outfitters seeks material cost visibility from expanded technology suite
entry.summary: The parent of several retail brands is tacking on additional features to its current production lifecycle management platform to improve supply chain efficiency.

entry.title: Schneider National says rail partner shift offers network boost
entry.summary: CEO Jim Filter said the company brings 35 years of intermodal service experience to its new partnership with Norfolk Southern.

entry.title: Unilever ramps up pricing to offset higher commodity costs
entry.summary: Improved visibility over supply of key inputs gave the CPG clarity to implement hikes after keeping prices flat during the first half of the year.

entry.title: Tilray Brands targets $20M in cost savings after craft brewery closures
entry.summary: The Shock Top owner has reduced its SKU count and closed four facilities as it adapts to beverage industry shifts.

entry.title: Lear to open automated factory as ‘blueprint’ for global network
entry.summary: The Michigan facility is expected to go live next year and be equipped with a host of automation tools, including two separate automated storage and retrieval systems.

entry.title: Aurora’s truck production schedule delayed by supply, quality issues
entry.summary: The autonomous trucking company is working with Roush to upfit trucks, and despite the delay, still expects to have more than 1,000 trucks ready by the end of 2027.
